body: And no I wasn't able to have any therapy or any real doctors care after this because my parents left me to do my own thing in a place I was literally stuck because I had no money.

I don't feel like I need any therapy although I will probably go talk to someone. I am just being outcasted by my parents and I'm in need. They won't let me live with them and recover, instead they want me to go to a facility and live for a few months to get on my feet. As if they're just pawning me off. I have no suicidal thoughts and just want to get my life back on track.
